record.paper_title: Extra extension properties of equidimensional holomorphic mappings: results and open questions
record.context_brief: Persistence of the meromorphic extension property in the limit fiber
record.original_question: Let {X_t} be a complex deformation of compact complex manifolds. Assume that every fiber X_t with t ≠ 0 has the meromorphic extension property, meaning that every meromorphic map from a domain in a Stein manifold extends meromorphically to the envelope of holomorphy of the domain. Does the central fiber X_0 also have the meromorphic extension property?

evidence.quote: Let’s give the formal statement. We say that a complex manifold X possesses a meromorphic extension property if for every domain D in Stein manifold every meromorphic mapping f : D → X meromorphically extends onto the envelope of holomorphy of D.
Question 4.1 Suppose all Xt for t ≠ 0 possed meromorphic extension property (as, for example, K¨ahler manifolds). Does X0 possesses it as well?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Say that a compact complex manifold X possesses the meromorphic extension property if, for every domain D contained in a Stein manifold and every meromorphic mapping f : D → X, the map f extends as a meromorphic mapping from the envelope of holomorphy of D into X.

Let π : 𝒳 → Δ be a proper holomorphic submersion from a complex manifold 𝒳 onto the unit disk Δ ⊂ ℂ, with all fibers X_t := π^{-1}(t) compact complex manifolds (so {X_t}_{t∈Δ} is a smooth complex deformation of compact complex manifolds).

Suppose that for every t ∈ Δ with t ≠ 0 the fiber X_t possesses the meromorphic extension property (for instance this holds whenever every X_t, t ≠ 0, is Kähler).

Question: Does the central fiber X_0 also possess the meromorphic extension property?
artifact.category_tag: Meromorphic extension in several complex variables
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not turn up a published resolution of this question. Related work by Ivashkovich establishes the meromorphic extension property for Kähler manifolds and analyzes obstructions in non-Kähler cases, but no source found confirms that the property is preserved under degeneration to the central fiber of a complex deformation in general. Status appears to remain open, but this could not be verified conclusively.

status_evidence.title: Extension properties of meromorphic mappings with values in non-Kähler complex manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Study of extension properties of meromorphic mappings into non-Kähler manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes background framework for meromorphic extension property but does not resolve preservation under deformation to a central fiber.

status_evidence.title: One example concerning extension and separate analyticity properties of meromorphic mappings
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a compact complex 3-manifold with partial extension behavior.
status_evidence.claim: Shows obstructions can occur for non-Kähler targets but does not address the deformation question.
